Type: lamp
Name: Pinzon Coconut Ball Table Lamp
Colors: Coconut
Bold and rustic, the Coconut Ball table lamp features real coconut shells in a mosaic tile effect Coconut shell orb base; burlap drum shade; gold cord Requires 1 bulb up to 100 watts; UL listed; 3-way switch for adjustable lighting Arrives assembled for immediate enjoyment Measures 26 inches high by 18 inches wide; weighs approximately 10 pounds
